title: Case-study page options
brief: Three structurally different case-study pages for the portfolio, all built on the real Brújula draft (docs/case-studies/brujula.md): two repositories, three ADR-backed decisions, screenshots still to capture

artboards.title: Dossier
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar editorial reading with a sticky table of contents and the repository map as centerpiece; the decisions read as prose, so they are less scannable

artboards.title: Decision record
artboards.tradeoff: Built around the decisions: each one shows the options side by side with the evidence, which is the strongest signal for tech leads; less story, and it depends on projects having real decisions to show

artboards.title: Walkthrough
artboards.tradeoff: Most memorable: a sticky system view changes as the reader moves through the steps; it needs the most script and careful reduced-motion and mobile fallbacks
